content.title: Canonical DONE domains, deeper bucket witnesses and actual child class preservation checked
content.text:
Checked code 834ef58c0a9295c8b0c073b934997289a23eacbf follows e52dfad185836bd0a19ec9be35e5ea8f39756d97 and d115b09cbdff1b0640ef9a650783ce0d217bd8c6. All 6005 prior non-Audit Lean files are byte-exact; six modules are added. No Haskell changes.

A closed Available explicit Union in a Normal + UnionNormal heap has a direct Mu member. With actual only-U atoms, it contains the FULL original U from the SAME accepted source/build and admits every finite TypeIn term at its exact native handle. Actual decision none = done plus CacheValid yields empty graph-bearing pending buckets and all TypeIn members under endpoint Normal/UnionNormal, original growth and only-U provenance. Cold source and source-without-Mu cases are retained. Actual target-query, enabled-empty and incoming-node operations preserve UnionNormal at all supplied budgets/outcomes. Whole-visitor provenance remains open.

The arbitrary-depth arrow-path producer constructs ONE assignment for the WHOLE selected bucket if every path uses indexes 1/2 and ALL paths are jointly prefix-free; its structural extension also satisfies BEFORE fragment equations. One original guard projection supplies prefix freedom, but actual conjunction can destroy it. Strict-prefix paths with UF-equivalent targets admit no finite assignment. This is a structural obstruction, not an accepted-source runtime counterexample. The new deeper result has no parked-prefix receipt; the older actual parked whole-child-path receipt remains.

Actual stored parent + literal own preparation + indexed staged child derives input avoidance from inherited and genuinely fresh targets. At the SAME supplied-budget actual shared ChildDispatch successful singleton, the parked root, handle, empty bucket AND its complete UF class are preserved. The proof composes terminal-prefix exclusion, fixed fold forest and real incoming findRoot compression. The prepared corollary retains complete Protected from captured through returned child cache. Existing isolation APIs remain unchanged. Retained empty/rejected/stopped caches and whole worker history remain open; raw [] incomingCacheAdapter with some cache is a concrete next case.

Source-pinned audits identify two main producer gaps. Actual warm target queries execute SourceEqualityNativeDemand checked code. Their PhysicalCache.Valid gives returned availability, not stronger thunk Produced replay; free-name scope does not imply only-U atoms. Prove actual returned NODE/EDGE payload provenance for closed and genuine mixed body/ref request families from actual empty cache history. For all removed obligations, sibling continuations restore captured symbolic cache while carrying native state forward, so each emitted output needs its own causal history. Temporal isolation does not establish path compatibility for prescribed later values.

Five public gates passed for the four domain/path modules and again for the two actual-child modules. Final source: 6012 files, 5011 direct Audit imports, 96742 aggregate theorem dependency reports, 227 explicit reports (225 standard, 2 axiom-free). Full SAME-root finite accepted completion under ONE assignment satisfying actual domains, paths, UF, residuals, readback, backward parked recompletion and ALL same-branch historical clears remains open. Preserve original fuels/budgets, all outcomes and earlier outputs after later stop. Full source/resource induction, completeness and compiled Haskell correspondence remain open.
